title: Remove deal entity and retarget Kanban board onto lead
description: The deal entity is removed from the CRM, but the Kanban board view MUST be kept and retargeted to display leads grouped by their pipeline stage (S1..S10 + Descartado). This is a combined ticket: first gut the deal-specific components (DealCreate, DealEdit, DealShow, DealInputs, DealArchivedList, dealUtils, stages.ts, deal FakeRest generators), then repurpose DealList / DealColumn / DealCard as LeadKanban / LeadKanbanColumn / LeadKanbanCard that reads from the 'contacts' resource filtered by lead-specific fields. The Kanban route moves from /deals to /leads/kanban or becomes the primary leads view. Deal-related notes (deal_notes) resource is removed. Dashboard DealsPipeline and DealsChart widgets are removed (analytics off). The 'deals' Resource in CRM.tsx is replaced by the new lead kanban routing.
acceptance_criteria: All files under src/components/atomic-crm/deals/ are deleted after their kanban-board logic is extracted and adapted into src/components/atomic-crm/leads/LeadKanban*.tsx
src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx no longer registers a 'deals' or 'deal_notes' Resource
A LeadKanbanColumn component renders one column per pipeline stage (S1..S10 + Descartado) ordered per spec
A LeadKanbanCard component shows lead name, telefono, and stage badge
The Kanban board is reachable via the main navigation (route /leads/kanban or as a view toggle on the leads list)
Dragging a card to another column updates lead.stage only for stages S6+ (S1-S5 columns are read-only; drag to them is blocked or a no-op with a user-facing message)
src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts removes the Deal and DealNote types
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/deals.ts and dealNotes.ts are deleted and imports removed from index.ts
supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql removes the deals and deal_notes table definitions
Dashboard no longer renders DealsChart or DealsPipeline widgets
App.tsx removes dealCategories, dealPipelineStatuses, and dealStages props

non_functional_requirements.performance: Kanban board loads leads list in <500ms for up to 200 leads
non_functional_requirements.security: Stage mutation via drag is blocked for S1-S5 (read-only ownership); RLS will further restrict advisor write scope in TASK-014
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Board capped at displaying 50 cards per column; pagination or virtual scroll for overflow
